# Shyena

> Shyena is an AI evaluation platform that tests AI systems before they ship. It is live today for testing and evaluating Cognigy-built conversational and voice AI agents, with RAG evaluation next. Shyena runs real, agent-driven conversations against a live Cognigy chat or voice bot, scores every turn with LLM-as-judge evaluation and deterministic assertions, and structurally prevents a broken conversation from reporting a false pass.

Shyena tests Cognigy agents the way a real customer would use them, not with scripted click-paths: each test case is an agentic persona with a goal and a behavioral playbook, and the executor improvises its next message based on how the Cognigy agent actually responded. Every turn is scored — by default 31 metrics per case, 117 in the full catalog including custom ones — and an execution-integrity gate caps any failed or truncated conversation at FAIL regardless of how well earlier turns scored, so a broken run can never report a green pass.

Shyena also offers Ziran, a separate open-source security/red-teaming tool for LangChain, CrewAI, Bedrock, MCP, and browser/HTTPS-driven agents.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://shyena.eu/): what Shyena is, why conversational AI needs a different testing model, and where it fits versus prompt testers, observability tools, and scripted chatbot testers.
- [Product](https://shyena.eu/product): full capability breakdown for testing and evaluating Cognigy conversational and voice agents — agentic test personas, real conversation execution, LLM-as-judge evaluation, deterministic assertions, the execution-integrity gate, and a Cognigy-specific FAQ.
- [Docs: Evaluation Model](https://shyena.eu/docs/evaluation-model): how Shyena's evaluation pipeline and metrics work.
- [Security (Ziran)](https://shyena.eu/security): the separate open-source red-teaming/security tool for LangChain, CrewAI, Bedrock, MCP, and browser/HTTPS agents.
